text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm rolling a small terraform change that adds a rotation hook for TLS certs in ExternalSecrets. plan attached.

maria: which cluster/namespace?

alex: prod cluster, namespace ingress. It's just adding annotation `external-secrets.io/rotation-hook: cert-rotate` and a patch to the Vault role to allow read on pki/issue/*

sam: can we avoid service restarts? how does ExternalSecrets propagate the updated secret? does it replace secret data only?

lia: ES replaces k8s Secret by default if `updateStrategy` set — newer ES versions do atomic updates. We should set `preserveMetadata: true` in the ES CR to keep labels/annotations.

alex: here's the current draft snippet for the ExternalSecret CR: 
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: tls-ingress
  namespace: ingress
  annotations:
    external-secrets.io/rotation-hook: "cert-rotate"
spec:
  refreshInterval: "30s"
  target:
    name: tls-ingress
    creationPolicy: Owner
    preserveMetadata: true
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-prod
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  data:
  - secretKey: tls.crt
    remoteRef:
      key: pki/issue/redwood-ingress
      property: certificate
  - secretKey: tls.key
    remoteRef:
      key: pki/issue/redwood-ingress
      property: private_key
```

maria: pinged infra-sre for the ServiceAccount binding changes, @sam can you review the RBAC? I added a Vault policy snippet: 
```hcl
path "pki/issue/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
```

sam: quick look — we probably want `list` as well for mount discovery. Also ensure the Vault role has allowed_common_name and ttl constraints.

lia: small nits: 30s refresh might be noisy for prod. Can we set 5m for prod and keep 30s in the canary? Rotation hook should be immediate via webhook if available, but we don't have that wired yet.

alex: good call. Plan update: use 5m for prod, add a canary in the ingress-nginx namespace with 30s refresh, and run a smokecheck that watches the k8s Secret checksum before/after rotation.

infra-bot: terraform plan for modules/secret-wiring completed — no resource drift detected. (apply pending)

maria: thanks. @alex please add the canary manifest and an e2e smoke script to the PR. I'll +1 after RBAC update.

sam: lgtm pending `list` capability and a follow-up note about KMS/CMK rotation if we later move private keys to AWS KMS.

alex: added both to the PR — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

lia: I'll run the smokecheck after merge, and I'll notify oncall if anything spikes.

alex: merging in 30m unless objections. :thumbsup:

maria: go for it.

sam: :thumbsup:

lia: :rocket:
